name: Expressions Washi Tape, Abstract Modern Design, 8 Rolls (C1017-8-P19)
bestUse: Best for borders, corners and tabs
descriptionOriginal: An eight-roll set of Scotch Expressions washi tape in an assorted Abstract Modern design.
whyWeLikeIt: One strip across a corner is often all a spread needs, and eight rolls from a named maker give you room to find the colour that agrees with your book. Scotch lists journaling among the uses of its Expressions washi.
limitations: Roll width and colourways are not confirmed for this exact set: Scotch's Expressions range is sold in widths from 7 to 15 mm, and some buyers on a retailer's page report receiving solid, muted colours rather than the patterns pictured. Scotch says to test removability on a small hidden area first, so this is tape for decorating paper, not a fix for a page you may want to lift later.
qualityNote: Customers say it is good quality with pretty patterns and vibrant colours. Concern: colourways and width are not stated in the page text, so look at the listing images before choosing it for a palette.

listingChecked.variant: 8 rolls, Abstract Modern (C1017-8-P19); colourways and width not confirmed
